leave_absence_reporting_013.evidence: Garland ISD uses a computerized system of entering absences and calling for substitutes. We call this system the Aesop System. The phone number to access this System is 1-800-942-3767. It is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The first thing you need to do is check with your campus office to make sure that your ID is your phone number and to assign your Personal Identification Number (PIN).
